Package com.example.fastwriting.model

Class Game

java.lang.Object
com.example.fastwriting.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Logic of the "Escritura Rapida" game: current level, current word, exact validation of the answer and time available per level.

Rules:

  • The game starts at level 1 with 20 seconds per level.
  • Every 5 completed levels the time decreases by 2 seconds, with a minimum of 2 seconds per level.
  • The answer must be exactly equal to the word (letters, spaces, capital letters and punctuation).
  • The game is won when MAX_LEVEL levels are completed.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Integrante 1, Integrante 2, Integrante 3
